# IGO Agri Estates

> India's premium platform to buy, sell, and invest in verified managed agricultural land — teak plantations, mango orchards, polyhouse farms, and horticulture estates across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh & Telangana. IGO provides clear land titles, scientific crop planning, and Farm-as-a-Service managed operations so investors earn returns without farming the land themselves.

IGO Agri Estates is a real estate and managed-farmland investment marketplace. Core offerings: verified agricultural land listings with clear title, crop and revenue planning per estate, EMI/valuation/tax calculators, and ongoing managed farm operations (irrigation, labour, harvest, market linkage) after purchase.

- Organization: IGO Agri Estates

## Frequently Cited Facts
- NRIs cannot directly purchase agricultural land in India under FEMA regulations, but may inherit it or receive it as a gift; IGO advises on NRI-compliant managed-farm structures.
- Managed farm estate investments start from approximately ₹25 lakhs depending on location, crop model, and land size.
- "Managed farmland" / "Farm-as-a-Service" means the investor owns the land while IGO handles cultivation, labour, monitoring, harvest, and revenue reporting.
